use_case: Predictive maintenance for customers' rod-pumped wells: a cloud dynamometer card analysis service classifies pump conditions and predicts failures; the owner uses the results to recommend pump changes or well servicing to Customers A and B
vendor_or_model: Dynamometer card analysis service provider (machine learning classification and failure prediction; SYS-08). Optional automatic optimization feature that can push setpoint changes to pump controllers: off and prohibited
data_categories: Dynamometer cards; run times; well codes (well names before 2026-09); customer production data (Confidential under the MSAs)
human_in_the_loop: Owner reviews every flagged well against the card and an on-site check before recommending work; the customer decides on any pulling unit or setpoint change and approves it in writing (POL-01 8.4)
applicable_laws: Customer A MSA item (5) (written consent for third-party services); Customer B MSA confidentiality clause; no AI-specific federal or Florida rule identified for this use
status: In production (in use since 2026-03; approved with conditions 2026-08-31; consent or no-training tier by 2026-09-30)

human_in_the_loop: Owner writes and checks every summary before sending
applicable_laws: Customer A MSA item (5); Customer C MSA confidentiality clause
